channel.title: AxiomCode — Changelog & service record
channel.description: Launches, changes, findings, fixes, incidents, and graduations. Append-only; no silent edits.

item.title: Verification report added — the resident boundary, proved
item.description: Anyone can now read how the harness's resident service is proved to stay inside its one granted directory — and where that proof's boundary lies, including the one place the code and its own documentation disagree. With this report, the register carries all five laws of the harness proof round.

item.title: Verification report added — the run supervisor fence, proved
item.description: Anyone can now read how the harness's supervisor is proved to judge its runs — by their artifacts alone, with resumes exact and the resume fence never crossed.

item.title: Verification report added — the index quarantine, re-proved against the fixed code
item.description: Anyone can now read the harness's index law in its strong form — quarantine by position, unconditional — alongside the record of the weaker form it replaced and the case that forced the fix.

item.title: Verification report added — the trace-ledger index quarantine, proved
item.description: Anyone can now read the harness's index law as proved — including the one case the proof found where the code's status rule trusts a sequence number the chain walk never reached.

item.title: Two verification reports added — the trace-ledger chain, proved, and its anchoring, proved
item.description: Anyone can now read the harness's ledger proofs as one chain of reports — gatekeeper, chain, anchored chain — each stating exactly what it established and where it stops.

item.title: Verification reports published — our own products, proven and bounded in public
item.description: Anyone can read exactly what our verification of our own products established — and where each proof stops.

item.title: Website redesign (P2) and the AppDocStudio documentation rebuild
item.description: Visitors, relying parties, and agents read the same generated facts in a documentation set shaped for their role; nothing about the service, its verdicts, or its billing state changed.

item.title: Status page, changelog, and practice page — one canonical source
item.description: Anyone — customer, auditor, or agent — can read the current state of every surface in one place, including what is paused, in soak, in design, or not built.

item.title: P0 closure: verdict taxonomy, pricing schema, security scope, status notes
item.description: No known false claim remains on the site; every surface states the same taxonomy, the same billing state, and the same scope.

item.title: Material wording corrections
item.description: Human pages, paperwork, and machine-readable mirrors state the same facts about MCP availability, FAILED certificates, and smart-contract scope.

item.title: Third-party signup promotion removed — ruled out fleet-wide
item.description: No AxiomCode surface promotes a third-party signup.

item.title: Finding F-AX-10: browser submission repaired
item.description: Browser submissions on /verify/ and /check/ complete end-to-end; API-key callers were never affected.

item.title: Ask shell launched
item.description: Conversational access to verification facts is live, with the fact/judgment boundary stated on the surface itself.

item.title: Public opening and hosted MCP
item.description: The service is open to humans, applications, and agents; certificates unlock when pack sales open.
